items.title: 12 Days of Christmas (LEGO)
items.description: Join in a super-silly Christmas celebration based on an all-new LEGO® holiday song! The holiday season can get a little kooky—especially when LEGO® friends come to visit. Get ready for Christmas with an ever-growing cast of merry guests, including festive robots and pirates. Inspired by an all-new video that puts a silly LEGO® spin on “The Twelve Days of Christmas,” this full-color hardcover picture book is sure to thrill boys and girls ages 3 to 7—and collectors of all ages.
